_instructions: Add 10-20 entries from vault notes you know well. Each entry: the question as you'd ask it, the source record id(s) that MUST answer it (copy from the source URL or API), and the search type to run. Entries with "sample": true are skipped by the runner. Run: python scripts/retrieval_qc.py evals/quality_fixture.json [--api http://localhost:5055] [--k 5]
_how_to_find_source_ids: Open the source in the UI; the id is the last path segment (source:<...>) or GET /api/sources and read ids.
